$comment: Routing cases for `agent-setup eval-routing`. `scope` = the skills these cases judge (@design = the catalog's design group); other kit skills may fire alongside and are reported, not judged. `first` = acceptable skills for the FIRST scoped skill the agent activates (any of). `none: true` = no scoped skill may activate. `forbid` = scoped skills that must not activate at any point in the run. `when` = a capability the case assumes; cases whose capability the agent under test lacks (per --assume) are skipped.
